Allah knows whatever is concealed or revealed in the breasts and all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He is over all things competent.
Allah is severe in penalty yet Forgiving and Merciful; the Messenger's duty is only to deliver, and Allah knows what people reveal and conceal.
He is Allah in the heavens and the earth, knowing what people keep secret, what they make public and what they earn.
Allah holds the keys of the unseen and knows everything on land and in the sea, every falling leaf and grain, all written in a clear record.
Allah witnesses every deed and every recitation of the Qur'an; not an atom's weight in the earth or heaven is absent from Him, and all is in a clear register.
The disbelievers turn away to hide, yet Allah knows what they conceal and declare; He provides for every creature and knows its dwelling and storage, all in a clear register.
Allah knows what every female carries, the unseen and the witnessed; concealed or open speech, and one hidden by night or seen by day, are alike to Him.
Your Lord knows you best and has mercy or punishes as He wills; He favored some prophets over others and gave David the Psalms.
Allah knows what is in the heaven and earth; it is all in a Record, and that is easy for Allah.
All in the heavens and earth belong to Allah, who knows people's state and will inform them of their deeds on the Day they return to Him.
The Lord is full of bounty though most are ungrateful, knows what breasts conceal and declare, and everything concealed in heaven and earth is in a clear Register.
Allah alone knows the Hour, sends the rain and knows what is in wombs, while no soul knows what it will earn tomorrow or where it will die.
Allah knows the unseen of the heavens and earth and what is within the breasts.
Knowledge of the Hour, of every fruit and every pregnancy is with Allah alone; on the Day He asks for His 'partners', those they invoked will be lost to them.
If they devise a plan, Allah also devises; He hears their secrets and private talk, and His messengers with them are recording.
Allah created man and knows what his soul whispers, being closer than his jugular vein, while two receivers on his right and left record every word.
Everything they did is in written records, and every small and great thing is inscribed.
Allah knows all in the heavens and earth; no three converse privately but He is the fourth, nor five but He is the sixth, wherever they are.
Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth, what people conceal and declare, and what lies within the breasts.
Whether people hide or publicize their speech, Allah knows what is within the breasts, for He created them and is the Subtle, the Acquainted.
The Prophet does not know whether the promised Hour is near; Allah alone knows the unseen, disclosing it only to approved messengers guarded by observers, and has counted all things.
